messages:
Anya: Quick check — can we shift next week's ARB from Tue 11am to Wed 9am PT? I have a client call that day.
Devon: Wed 9am works for me, but heads up infra sync collides for a few people.
Mike: Wed ok but prefer earlier than 9:30. If we move, can we lock a shorter agenda? :clock9:
Shreya: +1 to shorter. Also proposing a 'lightning lane' (10m) for 1–2 small RFCs so big topics keep full slots.
Anya: I like lightning lane. Proposal: 25m deep-review + 10m lightning + 5m admin = 40m total. Keeps things tight.
Samira: Sounds good. Two quick asks: (1) can facilitators nominate a shadow to take notes? (2) can we stack pre-reads into one Notion page? saves time.
Devon: For (1) yes — facilitator pairs would help continuity. For (2) please make a single pre-read doc per meeting, not per RFC.
Shreya: I can take facilitator for next Wed if we want rotating pairs. I'll shadow this time with Mike.
Mike: I'll shadow. Can we also add a short poll for priority RFCs? I have an infra PR that needs review: KV cache eviction policy RFC (link below).
Anya: KV cache eviction RFC: https://notion.so/r/kv-cache-eviction (pre-read uploaded). Add my +1 to prioritize that.
ARB-bot: Poll created by Anya — options: [KV cache eviction, Canary rollout guardrails, Autoscale policy], closes in 24h. /poll results will be posted here.
Devon: Minor nit: if KV cache goes to deep review, can we ask design author to prep a 5-slide TL;DR? speeds triage.
Samira: Agreed. Also adding a tiny agenda template to reuse:
Samira: ```
 - 2m open
 - 5m TL;DR by author
 - 15m discussion + decisions
 - 10m lightning lane (2x10m)
 - 8m action items & rollouts
```
Shreya: Love the template. Can we reserve the first lightning slot for the onboarding RFC (Sam's team)?
Samira: Yep I can cover onboarding RFC in the lightning slot.
Anya: Calendar update: Wed 9:00–9:40 PT, ARB — facilitator Shreya (shadow Mike). Notion pre-read page: https://notion.so/r/arb-2024-09-18
Devon: If anyone can't make Wed 9, please shout now. Otherwise I'll run the poll closure and publish the agenda.
ARB-bot: Poll closed — results: KV cache eviction 56%, Canary guardrails 30%, Autoscale 14%. Agenda pinned to Notion page.
Mike: Ack. I'll prep the 5-slide TL;DR for KV cache and drop it on the Notion pre-read.
Anya: Thanks all — facilitator pair set. Please add any other agenda items to the Notion page before EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
Devon: I'll publish the final agenda and meeting link at 8am Wed.
Shreya: Quick ops note — can we try starting meetings on the dot? last week ran long. I'll enforce 40m cap.
Samira: Cool. See you Wed.
Anya: Thanks folks!
